stem: An intentional breeding area and an unseeded-flower room have overlapping reproductive timing but are physically separated. Which statement best describes pollination risk?
choices: Risk depends on source, viable pollen movement, timing, receptive targets, containment, airflow, handling, and other pathways; distance alone does not prove zero risk
Physical separation alone proves zero risk
Any pollen-producing plant proves every flower in the facility will be seeded
Pollination risk can be determined from plant height
rationale: Pollination is a source-pathway-target process. Physical distance matters, but risk assessment also requires timing, containment, movement pathways, and target receptivity.
